notes.title: The different levels of progression in Zoeti
notes.content:
Zoeti is out now on Steam, which means players around the world have the opportunity to become an Astral Envoy and seal away a powerful demon trying to end the world. To do so, you’ll use a deck of playing cards to make poker hands, using a full house or a flush to activate a variety of skills and abilities from the game’s playable characters, Valentina, Alves, and Nicora. And like any roguelite, you only have one shot to take down the big boss. If you play the wrong build, you’re out of luck and need to start all over again. If that happens, though, don’t fret! You’ll still progress through the game and this blog is all about what that progression looks like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/32f4d53d0854ed1bd6b651f57020ec6d150c5526.jpg[/img]

There’s four forms of out of game progression in Zoeti, difficulties, maps, game modes and character experience. Whenever you embark on a mission, if that mission is successful, you will unlock new aspects of the game to explore. Beating a mission on Normal, for instance, unlocks the Hard difficulty. Beating the first story map in Story Mode opens up the second story map. And beating story mode will unlock Adventure Mode, a randomized run pulling from all three story maps to create a truly epic experience to play through. All of those only unlock when you successfully defeat challenges, however, and failed runs won’t affect difficulties, maps and game modes. Successful and failed runs will, however, alter how your characters play, granting experience which allows your adventurers access to new skills and items on your next run. 

Successful runs in Story Mode will unlock new maps to play and new difficulties to play on. For instance, completing the first map, Saintly Trial, on Normal difficulty will unlock the same map at Hard difficulty and unlocks the second map in Story Mode, Hidden Danger, at Normal difficulty. While Saintly Trial on Hard will challenge you with stronger enemies capable of dealing more damage, attacking more times and having more powerful buffs, they will ultimately be the same enemies attacks and buffs native to that run. You won’t see new bosses or monsters in the random pool at Hard difficulty, they will just be more powerful and require more coordination to take down. This same principle is true for every jump in difficulty in the game, from Normal to Hard to Horrific to Nightmare to Inferno. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/cad32c74382a42cf42337cf40857b30719a1a4cb.jpg[/img]

The Hidden Danger, however, will challenge you with new monsters, new bosses, and new mechanics throughout your run. In Saintly Trial, you’ll never have to face elemental damage as the fiends you come across in the idyllic plains don’t attack you with the power of Fire or Frost damage. The Hidden Danger, set in the towering mountains overrun with demons trying to free the most powerful of their ilk, introduces Frost damage for the first time to players as well as Chanted spells, channeled for powerful effects that require the player to do enough damage to interrupt them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/d5fe3fe11435e80260ad8825eae6fdcf97cf2865.jpg[/img]

Once all three Story Mode maps have been defeated, you’ll unlock Adventure Mode, a randomized experience that pulls from all three of the Story Mode maps. Every mechanic from all three maps can be in the pool, as well as monsters and events unique to the individual story mode maps. Adventure Mode does include narrative events and experience but it doesn’t include the same kind of plot-centered experience that Story Mode offers. Where in Story Mode, you’ll follow some of your friends like Snowball the Innkeeper or Giseca the Valkyrie as they tell their stories, in Adventure Mode, you’ll skip those kinds of narrative, dialogue-based experiences for something that gets you right into the gameplay.

But you won’t just progress with the kinds of difficulties and maps you can play with, you’ll also progress the characters who you’ll be playing as in your Saintly Trial to become a Star-Soul Hero. Valentina the Knight, Alves the Assassin, and Nicora the Sorceress all have levels and need you to run maps in order to level them to max. Each character has ten levels and each level they reach unlocks three new skills which can be offered in your next run. While all three characters tend to start with fairly basic, straightforward mechanics, as you level them up and master their playstyles more and more, you’ll start to see more advanced effects unlocked for them. Similarly, every level will unlock a specific accessory that character can discover in their runs, an item that will power them up as they take the fight to the fiends threatening the land. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/6961dc521cc155df81cfb6d835839bb22369a96d.jpg[/img]

If you want to level all three characters to max, see the story of Zoeti unfold before you, and defeat the most powerful bosses on Inferno difficulty, you can play it today on Steam! Let us know what you think of it in the [url=https://discord.gg/akuparagames]Akupara Games Discord[/url] or on the [url=https://twitter.com/akuparagames]Akupara Games Twitter[/url]!  

-Riv Otter

notes.title: Zoeti is out now!
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

[b]Oil your armor, sharpen your blades, and prepare your spells, [i]Zoeti[/i] is now out![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2VCnbPaE7ck

Zoeti is a turn-based roguelite that features a deck of playing cards used to create card combos and activate skills in the heat of battle. Bolster your arsenal through battles, discoverable upgrades, or aid from the locals which enhance your plays to overcome the evil plaguing your land.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A Royal Flush[/b] - Every ability is associated with a poker hand; the more complex the hand, the more impactful the ability!
[*] [b]Create a Powerful Arsenal[/b] - Upgrade, purchase, or quest for new skills for your runs. Discover new synergies to overcome your opposition and create mechanically rich strategies.
[*] [b]Your Choices Have Consequences[/b] - Risk everything on a tough fight with an exceptional reward or take the easy path to guarantee victory.
[*] [b]Meet Fuzzy Friends[/b] - From Winfred the cheerful innkeeper with a powerful secret to Rabelle, the devious scoundrel just as likely to trick you as to help you.
[*] [b]Endless Possibilities[/b] - Three different game modes playable with three different characters at five different difficulties featuring dozens of different builds and hundreds of different enemies... Every run is unique!
[/list]

[b]To celebrate the launch of Zoeti, Zoeti is launching with a 10% discount![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434540/Zoeti/ 

Remember to give Zoeti a review when you play it!

notes.title: Map Pathing Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

I’m excited to finally talk about Zoeti and some of the strategies that go into each run! In this dev log, I’m going to break down the choices that go into your decisions on the map. In the future, I’ll talk about each turn, the different character playstyles, and more.

Choosing the best path will be a foundational skill for each run you begin. One wrong move on the map can lead to the run ending or receiving tons of preventable damage. Each path will have its own layout and rewards for completing them and those rewards can be sand dollars that you use in shops, accessory items to help in battle, skills to refine your build, items which can swing a battle, and soulstone fragments which help you upgrade your abilities. Understanding which each path brings will help evaluate the risks and rewards of each path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/b01948c6f6293f9f1500217faa06c158b8d9431c.png[/img]

Each node in the path contains a different interaction that triggers when you arrive there the lines connecting the nodes show where you can travel next.  At the end of the path, there will be a special encounter such as an elite battle or boss that you must face in order to continue on.

[h2]Type of Spaces[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/26bafbe0b823ac0bfe8be1a86325d3ab092de61d.png[/img]

[h3]Enemy[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/bbdfd710f70653836cb7ca5c256ba3fa0fe29c28.png[/img]
The enemy will be the most common node on the path. Here you can expect a battle with various enemies. For beating the enemies, you can gain sand coins for shops, soulstone fragments to upgrade your character, and a skill to add to your deck.

[h3]Shop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/d05ebda85025c90b3cdea2ebe86c75ff63ac6241.png[/img]
At shop nodes, you can use your sand coins to buy accessories and items. Accessories are passive buffs that affect battle and items help turn the tide of battle when you activate them.

[h3]Campfire[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/40886e0c353db7ef0d464a04dbf38dee2110a119.png[/img]
Campfire nodes allow you to heal and mediate. You can rest, healing 25% of your hp and meditate, upgrading your skills or abilities using soulstone fragments. These are most common right before the end of the path.

[h3]Idol[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/0829ba6ddc1a106f21a07edc576ba9a4dfd81c0f.png[/img]
When you go to an idol node, you will discover an idol to one of the game’s four gods that will give you up to four different options. Early in the game, you’ll be presented with two choices: One free, one costing a small amount for a small boon. But as you progress deeper, idols will progressively offer you more and more powerful accessories and items for higher and higher costs.. Different idols will have different rewards and costs, depending on which of the four gods you’re asking for favor. Keep an eye out for another devlog in the not-too-distant future showing off the four gods and what powerful items they have on offer!.

[h3]Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/a8065805d007aca9967fd1fc82435cbc7cfb61de.png[/img]
You have made it! You hit the final node at the end of the path where you will have your toughest fight! Will it be a boss monster demanding all your skill, power and cunning? Will it be an elite battle, pitting you against a collection of the strongest fiends on the field? Will it be an event battle, where you fight against waves of enemies without the opportunity to rest? Will you need to defend on the altars of the gods from assailing monsters, teaming up with other star envoys to do so? Depends on your map and its pathing!

That is everything in the map! Remember to choose your path carefully and plan ahead in your route. That can be the difference between a successful run and a failed one. My good friend Buddy has been streaming Zoeti on Fridays, which will include this upcoming Friday for some brand new game content!. If you would like to get notified when he goes live, join the Akupara Games Discord!

- Riv Otter

notes.title: Akupara Games Will Publish Zoeti in 2023!
notes.content:
Hey! 

I’m Buddy, the Community Manager for [url=https://www.akuparagames.com/]Akupara Games![/url] I wanted to take a second to introduce myself since Akupara is partnering with Dusklight Games for the upcoming release of card-based roguelike, Zoeti. 

Today, Zoeti will be a part of the Hamburg Game Conference, complete with a digital booth and a little sneak peak into what the game is like. Also, we’re announcing that the game will no longer be entering Early Access; instead, it will see a full launch for all players in 2023. 

I’m going to be spending a ton of time in the Steam Discussion threads for Zoeti, so if you have any questions or comments, feel free to ask away over there. I’ll also be hanging out in [url=discord.gg/akuparagames]the Akupara Games Discord[/url] answering questions about the game, explaining mechanics, and everything in between. And I’ll be making a ton of video content for Zoeti once we get closer to launch, so keep an eye out for that on our official YouTube channel. 

Anyway, that’s about it from me! I can’t wait to show you all the cool Zoeti news we have brewing over the next few months! It’s gonna be a blast. 

-Buddy

notes.title: "Zoeti" Participated in Tokyo Game Show and Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
"Zoeti" is a strategy game that integrates mild Roguelike, poker elements, and tower climbing strategy.
The gameplay is a unique combat gameplay that uses playing cards to activate skills. The combat mechanism combines the design of tower-climbing strategy games such as [Slay the Spire] and [Griftlands].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/52e5df71ae810042934817131281e8c3cc3841eb.jpg[/img]

The game will participate in the 2021 Tokyo Game Show ONLINE from September 30th to October 3rd, and then participate in the Steam Next Fest from October 1st to October 7th. The demo version will be available for download on Steam from September 30th to October 7th. Interested players can join the watch or wish list.
